title: Telemetry ingest proxy for LLM KPIs and Prometheus/OTel harmonization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight telemetry ingest proxy that accepts both OTLP metrics (gRPC/HTTP) and Prometheus remote_write, normalizes labels, enriches inference-specific attributes (model_id, model_variant, shard_id, routing_tier), and emits harmonized metrics and derived inference KPIs into our downstream pipeline (Kafka -> enrichment -> timeseries/OLAP). Goal: provide a single consistent entry point for LLM telemetry to reduce client drift, control cardinality, and enable per-model SLOs (p50/p95/p99 latency, token throughput, KV cache hit-rate, error-rate by route). The proxy will support label mapping rules, deterministic request attribution for multi-tenant routing, adaptive sampling, and backpressure/queuing with rate/adaptive throttling. Design emphasizes minimal added latency on the hot path and safe defaults to avoid accidental high-cardinality ingestion.
comments: 2025-02-13 - Kickoff: reviewed scope with Observability (Priya Rao) and Platform (Jamal Singh). Agreed to support both OTLP and Prom remote_write to minimize client changes.

2025-02-18 - Design review: added deterministic attribution to avoid double-counting when requests traverse proxies and gateways. PM asked to keep model_id as first-class label. Action: add label canonicalization module.

2025-02-22 - Prototype: spike implemented receiver in Go using otelcol components and prometheus remote_write adapter. Prototype repo: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/ingest-proxy (initial commit). Observed ~3ms median added latency under 1k rps load.

2025-02-26 - Load testing: 20k rps scenario produced a 95th latency increase of 12ms; memory usage dominated by label buffer. Trade-off discussion: introduce label cardinality caps and a config-driven sampling policy. Assigned SRE to run extended soak.

2025-02-28 - Security review kickoff: security requested schema registry for label keys and a short retention for raw events in the proxy for debugging. Marked security_review_required = true. Planning to use existing KMS integration for any artifacts.

2025-03-01 - Implementation: opened PR with core receiver + label mapper + deterministic attribution logic: github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/1250. Requesting infra review and a canary rollout plan for us-west2.

Next steps: finalize schema registry, add metric transform rules for histogram bucketing (p50/p95 derivation), implement adaptive sampling, and create SLO dashboards linking derived KPIs to console rollouts.
Follow-ups: add integration tests with our metrics enrichment pipeline and a runbook for proxy overload conditions (circuit-breaker -> fallback to direct client remote_write).
